{{DISPLAYTITLE:petnick}}
[[File:Petnick avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|petnick.]]
'''petnick''' is an artist whose images are used on six [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of petnick @ DeviantArt". The credit points to DeviantArt, an online art community. The credited cards are [[General Poe Dameron|•General Poe Dameron]], [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel|•Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]], [[Ben Solo|•Ben Solo]], [[A Good Friend|•A Good Friend]], [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)|•A New Hope]], and [[The Force Will Be With You, Always|•The Force Will Be With You, Always]], in [[Virtual Set 22]], [[Virtual Set 23]], [[Virtual Set 24]], [[Virtual Set 25]], and [[Virtual Set 27]] (released 2023–2026).
